planned_argument_object.prompt:
Edit the supplied poster into ONE finished flat opaque landscape 16:9 poster, retaining its expansive diagonal open-room section and all event information. This is the own inspected edit target, not a style sample.

Observed issue to correct: the ceiling wood grain, glossy reflected floor, detailed tree/leaves and softly shaded realistic surfaces make the room look like an architectural visualization. Redraw the ROOM AND PEOPLE as a clean architectural ink illustration with restrained perspective, crisp structural edges, limited flat plane colors and no surface grain or polished reflections. Warm white wall/floor planes, deep teal cut faces, charcoal ink lines, pale apricot skylight planes. Use plane overlap and controlled line weight for depth, not photo-real material texture. Simplify small adults to poised adult silhouettes with minimal flat clothing details and clear foot contact, keeping their current modest scale and activity. Remove the ornamental tree and its leaf shadows; retain the shared light shape as the central relationship. Keep the wall-mounted architectural-light photographs as four distinct unlettered photographic images inside the illustrated space, with clean thin boundaries. They show anonymous light/opening/shadow geometry, no identifiable real buildings.

Protected relationships: preserve the large section's ascent from lower left to upper right, crop at screen edges, deep teal sliced outlines, continuous shared floor and ceiling, skylight beam spanning the exhibition wall and conversation area, three viewing adults and the four-adult conversational group, their adult proportions, and the information's existing reading route. Keep the subtitle and practical schedule/participation outside the left cut edge, the modest identity at upper right beside the wall end, and visiting/welcome just beyond the lower-right floor edge. No centered isolated building model, isometric toy, technical drawing ornament, equipment clutter, physical paper model, collage, blueprint or institution promotion.

Preserve EVERY existing printed entry exactly once with the SAME spelling, word spacing, punctuation and numerals. Do not replace, omit or duplicate copy. All eleven entries remain one horizontal line each. The initial text is already correct. Keep the en dash in the time range and exact middle dots. Korean humane sans with regular proportions/open counters; English wide tracking. Make the two lower-right visiting/welcome lines slightly larger, about 15.5px at width 720, while retaining their area beyond the floor edge and avoiding structural collisions. All practical information must remain readable at usage width 720. No added copy, labels, dimensions, room names, photo captions, pseudo-print, logos, QR or watermark.

The actual illustrated section must continue organizing image/type/space. Do not fall into a passive solid/near-solid/split-color background with dominant oversized gothic title/date/info blocks and subordinate inset or bottom-strip imagery. Thin texture, gradient, grid or font change cannot cure that excluded template. Keep exactly one separate flat opaque poster, not a mockup, comparison panel or contact sheet.
